title: The Apostle's Peace as the Cosmic Letter
description: When the Apostle opens with peace and greeting, what stands behind that salutation is the whole structural conversation between the Lord and the soul — the summons going forth and the hearing rising up to meet it. The Call sent out from the Lord's operative power, and the Hearing by which the rational receives that Call, together compose what may rightly be called a letter: a letter of peace and greeting, in which everything that has come to pass between soul and source is set down, and everything still to come is set down with it. The rational receives such a letter, inscribed with all the tidings of the soul, every contest, every answer, every step prepared. Nothing is hidden from the Lord, who has carried it through with the soul.
